description: Public TikTok and YouTube videos already linked to rising games, sorted by views (url, network, views, publish date, game). Filter by game, a title keyword or platform; page with nextCursor. Use them to study hooks; videos are tracked for the games Wieldr shows most (top of the radar, Signal of the week, anomalies, niche leaders) on Roblox, Fortnite and Steam.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to get the next page. Omit for the first page.

game.description: Wieldr game id (e.g. "roblox-2640407187", "steam-570" or "fortnite-1234-5678-9012", returned by other tools), a Fortnite island code ("1234-5678-9012") or a game title (case-insensitive; the most played match wins, other matches are listed).

limit.description: How many results per page (default 10, max 30).

niche.description: Word in the game title, e.g. "tycoon".

platform.description: steam, roblox, ios, itch (itch.io) or fortnite. Omit for all platforms.

name: get_viral_videos

dataset.description: full radar (member key or sign-in) or free preview (no key).

method.description: One useful sentence; full definitions in the MCP resource wieldr://methodology.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null = last page.

planNote.description: Creator plan only: fields left out of this answer because they are included in Pro, and where to see the plans.

planRequired.description: Present INSTEAD of the data when the tool, or this call, is not in the member's plan: nothing was looked up. Relay message and pricingUrl.
